summary: NVIDIA filed an 8-K reporting a multi-year partnership with SB Energy to develop the PORTS Technology Campus AI data center site in Ohio. NVIDIA entered residual value guaranties covering approximately 4.25 GW of IT load, with additional credit support up to 3.8 GW. Aggregate payment obligations are capped at $105 billion, effective upon lease commencement, expected from 2028. OpenAI is the tenant. These are strategic operational and financing arrangements, not a special-situation corporate action. The filing outlines contingent credit support mechanics, remedies upon tenant default, and termination conditions. Watch for lease commencement and any triggered guaranty payments.
